finding: The harness=false original_loading_present executable had no global_allocator. Enabling the Cargo mimalloc feature does not by itself install the allocator. All frozen baseline/V1/V2/V3 binaries therefore used the system allocator.
retained_scope: GPU correctness, actual WSI, capacity-wait counters and same-fixture AB comparisons remain valid in that configuration; not shipped-binary CPU/performance acceptance.
correction: Fixture now selects the same cfg(feature=mimalloc) global allocator as both shipped entry binaries. Final matrix uses production-v4; optional CPU profiler compiled but disabled during formal timings.
partial_v3_matrix: Stopped intentionally; incomplete runs marked interrupted and excluded.
additional_cleanup: Removed three unused synchronous frame_present_complete wrappers from ProductionRenderer, threaded wrapper and GameLoop. Published frame_observation and actual native-present counters remain the current consumers.
diagnostics: Existing optional host pprof sampler moved into frame_counters and reused by WSI fixture; 997 Hz, opt-in TG_PROFILE_OUT, filename/line attached to collapsed stacks. Normal runs clear all TG_PROFILE_ variables.
